{{Quote|How about an eopie? I'm also part owner of Eopies Extraordinaire.|Tevar Shan to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>}}
'''Tevar Shan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and owner of [[Ronto-Rama Farms]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and partial owner of [[Eopies Extraordinaire]]. He approached [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] at the [[Grand Event Center]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the annual [[Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition]] to try to sell her both, and was politely turned down.

==Behind the scenes==
Tevar Shan was created by author [[Christie Golden]] for her first ''[[Star Wars]]'' novel, and the second novel in the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''.
